info.name: DiskMap
info.summary: See where your storage is going — treemap and top consumers, instance-wide
info.description:
DiskMap shows where storage is going across your Nextcloud instance — per user and per team folder — without scanning anything.
Nextcloud already tracks aggregated folder sizes in its file cache, updated on every operation. DiskMap is a visualizer over data that already exists: it never triggers a filesystem scan.
Each view pairs a WinDirStat-style treemap with an expandable folder tree, kept in sync both ways: click a tile on the map and the tree opens to that file, click a row in the tree and the map highlights its region.
**For administrators:** - Whole-server view: every account, team folder and external storage as a top-level entry, browsable down to individual files. - Team folders overview: used space, quota and occupancy, with a files / trash / versions breakdown for each folder.
**For every user:** - The same treemap and folder tree over your own storage, with quota occupancy and a files / trash / versions breakdown.
All figures show the timestamp of the underlying file cache entry, so it's always clear this reflects what Nextcloud's cache knows, not a live disk read.
info.author: Ricardo Ferreira
